ValidationRule.description: On the eHS Initiatives and HIS record type, Care Program can only be populated when Contact is not blank and Product is CIICPAR - CPAR. Care Program is never required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "eHS_Initiatives_and_HIS", NOT(ISBLANK(eHS_Care_Program__c)), OR( ISBLANK(ContactId), Product2.Name <> "CIICPAR - CPAR" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Care Program can only be populated when Contact is not empty and Product is CIICPAR - CPAR. Please clear the Care Program field, or ensure Contact is not empty and Product is CIICPAR - CPAR.
